conventions: 'fact' on a line names the card or cards the builder shows with it: the exact text and figure from the source file, figure in large type, fact beneath. Lines carry no figures of their own; every number the player reads comes from a card.
'src' names the passage a line paraphrases. It is for checking only and is never shown.

A quiz or examiner id means the builder shows the item exactly as the source file holds it. In a rehearsal the best choice is a short gist of the model answer; after any choice, reveal the full model answer by its id.
No appendix page numbers anywhere. Since 2 Nov 2026 some appendix parts are held by the author; where one comes up the keeper says so, in a line marked held_by_author.
UK English. No em dashes in game copy. Every character is fictional; participants appear only as interview codes inside fact cards; authors and real firms appear only inside fact cards.
'optional': true marks side content outside the 3-minute story path. 'format': 'say_then_reveal' means answer aloud, reveal by id, then self-rate.

Images img-00 to img-18 are the 19 already made. S01 to S10 and V01 to V08 exist (all 8 videos are in assets/video). Shot-list items marked status 'new' are still to be made; 'redo' replaces an existing image.
Humour comes from the situation and from what each character wants. Names may pun; lines may not.
One idea per line. Dialogue lines at most 30 words, subtitles at most 25. Exclamation marks only from a referee or a judge.
Every 'you' line must be sayable in the viva unchanged.
Never shorten a finding by dropping its condition ('unless a wall, a penalty or an owner with no stake'; 'bound from outside'; 'of those recorded'; 'one reason').
Every time link 5 appears on the story path it carries 'proposed'. The red-cell rule always says 'should' or 'shouldn't', never 'can't'.
No dead lines: if the card carries the content, the line asks or frames.
No figures in lines, subtitles, choices or feedback. Allowed names: rule 1a, P1 to P5, 1B and other objective numbers, S + P and L + W. Every number comes from a card.

Every pick of three or four replies passes the length gate: the best reply is at most 1.25 times the mean length of the others, and is the longest in no more than 35 per cent of a set. Wrong replies are near-misses with one named error ('error' field), and the feedback names it. Wrong replies in rehearsals and the Grill carry no figures.
Any reference to a part held by the author carries a held_note, and the answer he learns to give is 'held by the author, available on request'.
One question inside every scene ('in_scene'), from that act's quiz, unchanged, about something the scene has just shown.
Narration (CN) is held to the subtitle rules: 25 words at most, no figures, no em dashes, link 5 always 'proposed', the red-cell rule always 'should'. Marigold frames; the cards state.
'voice_verbatim_of' names a card read aloud word for word; the clip carries a text stamp of the source and mutes if the source changes. Verbatim reads are never typed.
Explainer captions are the methods_facts.json video_brief narration by reference ('captions_from'); every number on screen in a motion diagram is read from a bound card at run time.
The courier's lines are never voiced: they show with a microphone glyph as 'Your line', and he says them.
Family mode changes pictures, sound, animation and buttons only. No shown string differs between modes except the co-pilot dock.
No crime words in shown text: police, bust, busted, wanted, arrest, crime. Ids may keep old names.
'docket_spot': true marks a film shot where the builder places Docket's peeking overlay (family mode only), clear of subtitles and cards.

meta.play_length: About 33 hours of play where every minute teaches: story path with films and Academy missions about 5 h; ten Locker rooms about 5 h; parcels about 2 h; Academy optional lessons about 4 h; spaced review over weeks 8 to 10 h; Waiting Room mocks about 3 h; 11 or more boss attempts about 5.5 h. No step runs past 10 minutes without a save; any film beat is 45 s or less.
meta.supersedes: script_v2.json. Swap in as assets/data/script.json only after the v3 save, migration and level select ship and are proved live (build_v3.md, step 1).
v2_summary: Accuracy pass: 19 drifting lines fixed (review D1 to D19), cheesy lines rewritten, captions turned into points.
Spine taught in play: aim, question and objectives in 1.3; the chain lights link by link; the findings in 7.1; P1 to P5 in the Last Run.
New scenes 4.4 (power) and 5.4 (the survey); critical facts moved onto lines; one question inside every scene.
Main-path rehearsals 7 to 12, plus bank fin-25 lent to Act 4; every pick rewritten as near-misses that pass the length gate.
Mechanics: Act 3 whistle, Act 4 present the evidence (hearts tutorial), Act 6 the scale, Act 7 rebuild the parcel, then a mock viva.
Say it aloud: the one sentence in 1.3 and at every boss attempt; one on-air moment per act; the one-sentence ladder.
New cutscenes: cold open, Previously, seven act closers, What holds them, Sold, The chain, The Hall opens, the reveal, the killer insert, the Not awarded loop, First bust, Second half.
Held by the author marked everywhere it applies; Ghent's gap-25 and app-J-eq1 restored (Appendix J keeps the Dutch).
Boss: think first with confidence, compact feedback, proportional draw by topic, killers capped at 4, follow-ups capped at 5, pause and resume.
Coverage: every key fact taught (line, card or parcel) and tested (quiz, rehearsal or figure recall); every gap taught and tested in its room.
v3_summary: Saves that cannot break: five per-person documents, a verified local mirror, ten snapshots (the Time Machine), save code FCV3, migration v1 to v2 to v3, a fuzz gate.
A World Map level select: every step, act, room, mission and Academy lesson restarts in one click, with Undo and a snapshot.
A toon-shaded three.js city (2D fallback), a cutscene Director, GSAP motion, a procedural Tone.js score, voiced cast and a narrator, Marigold Post.
Longer films: 58 to 69 s act openings in two beats, Before/After turning points, 40 s closers read aloud, the Long Ride, a real finale and a Not awarded that comforts.
The Methods Academy: all 82 methods entries as lessons, 10 methods missions (5 in Act 3), 15 explainers.
Mastery: five stages per item, readiness bands, a boss predictor, a Shift Check at every closer, an error clinic, the Waiting Room mock.
Family mode: Docket the co-pilot dog, co-pilot jobs and a dock, Tell your co-pilot, Dot patrol, Kid drive, races, stunt jumps, the Parade and photo, Bedtime and Good morning.
Every session ends with 'What you learnt today', built only from item memory.
Kerb Inspectors and 'Spot check' replace police and 'Busted'; no crime words anywhere shown.
New mechanics: Fill the Blank Quarter (Act 1), Cast the Net (Act 2), the Gate Run built (Act 5), and a mini-game for every methods mission.

premise: Freight City runs on parcels and rivalry: carriers chase the same doors, so the shared van so rarely arrives.
You are a courier with one parcel, your thesis, addressed to the Viva Hall.
You rode in believing the Big Fierce Animal stands alone because it is big. Seven districts are about to correct you, one chapter each.

lines.line: Freight FM, live. Courier: horizontal collaboration, in plain English?
Organisations at the same point in the chain: carriers with carriers, shippers with shippers, or one public body with another.
And who did the field actually study?
Carriers. So I asked its map one question: where are the shippers?
The newest reviews must file them somewhere.
Neither has a category for who begins a collaboration.
Any case of carriers starting one together and measuring the result?
Not one, in the review or its update.

items.prompt: A cartographer's desk under a lamp: a huge hand-drawn map of a sunset city, every district coloured in except one blank fogged patch near the centre; a magnifying glass resting on the blank; a courier's parcel at the map's edge.

The Big Fierce Animal: a towering delivery van built like a rhinoceros, armour plates, glowing headlight eyes, horn-shaped bull bar, steam from the bonnet, looming over a narrow street at dusk while small cargo bikes and vans scatter. Menacing but comic. Plain paint, no logo.

Archive Hill: tall library stacks climbing a hillside at golden hour; a librarian hauls a single glowing string net through the shelves, catching a small neat bundle of books while a whole lit shelf behind it sits untouched.

Witness Court: a grand courtroom lined with tall mirrors; in two reflections the same plain delivery van appears, doors flung open in welcome in one, slammed shut in the other; rows of empty witness chairs; warm dramatic light.

A car-free old Flemish city street with stepped gables and a glimpse of canal, morning light; a gantry of number-plate cameras over a narrow cut; a cargo bike gliding through while a plain white van waits at a raised bollard.

Red Cell Square: a glossy round red parcel-locker kiosk shaped like a red blood cell, a smooth disc dipped in the middle with no core, in a sunny plaza; beside it a cheerful keeper in a plain red uniform with no badge holds a ring of keys; vans in different plain colours queue politely.

film_rules.beats: at most 45 s a beat; a 'Carry on' chevron for 1.5 s between beats, then it carries on (family mode waits for a tap)
film_rules.control: back within 90 s everywhere except the finale and the endings
film_rules.timing: a shot lasts the longest of the video, the voice plus 0.6 s, the card's reading time (2.5 s + 0.25 s a word) and 3 s; videos hold their last frame and never loop
film_rules.replays: seen films play core shots only unless 'Full' is chosen; skip by beat; hold to fast-forward at 2x
film_rules.controls: Skip (applies the end state), Pause, Back; resumes at the start of the shot if the tab closes
film_rules.never: never between a question and its feedback
film_rules.fallbacks: every video falls back to its poster, then its still, then a gradient

methods_academy.name: The Methods Academy
methods_academy.where: A red-brick school with a whistle weathervane in the Method Works district (LS01); lessons in a bright classroom (LS02).
methods_academy.opens: After scene 3.1, with the academy entrance (CN-ACADEMY over LS01). Field lessons for Acts 1, 2, 4, 5, 6 and 7 open with their acts; every lesson is open after Act 3's closer and from the Chapter Map at any time.
methods_academy.source: methods_facts.json (82 entries, by id). Lesson id: method:<id>. Quiz item: method:<id>:q<K>. Viva question: method:<id>:v<K>. Gap: method:<id>:gap.
lesson_shape: Watch: the explainer, where the entry is video_worthy (generated mood clip, then the in-engine motion diagram; captions are the brief's narration by reference)
Plain meaning: the 'plain' field as a card, read aloud by Marigold (voice id VO-M-<id>)
How it was done here: 'in_this_thesis', one step at a time, with the thesis cards it points to
Why this, not that: 'why' and 'not_this' as say then reveal, point-checked
The analogy: the 'analogy' field, on a picture card (family mode reads it aloud too)
Probes: the entry's quiz items; items that fail the length gate are asked as say then reveal
Viva questions: say then reveal with the point-check; each is a Tier B proof context
The gap, where the thesis gives no reason: say it in the thesis's words
rules: No words are written for a lesson: every shown string is a field of methods_facts.json or a card by id.
A lesson is a save point after every step.
Methods quiz and viva items join one memory (boxes, days played) and the Night Shift; the viva questions join the Waiting Room mock pool. None is a bank item.

Lessons order by methods_facts.json 'order'; inside the Academy the menu sorts unseen core lessons first, then by bank demand (logistic regression is not a methods entry, so bank demand only reorders, it never adds).

act1.name: The Sorting Office
act1.mechanic_rules: Each card drops down a chute; send it left (finding) or right (proposition). Items: drill:finding_or_proposition, then the lesson quiz items. A right sort rings the bell; a wrong one slides the card back with its source card.
act1.stamp: bronze: finish; silver: one miss at most; gold: no miss and every core 'why' Nailed
act1.length: about 8 to 12 min on the main path (core lessons); the rest are optional at the Academy

act2.name: The Search Room
act2.mechanic_rules: The PRISMA funnel (motion diagram bound to ch2-01 and ch2-06): drag the stage counts into order, then the lesson quiz items. Every number comes from the cards.
act2.stamp: bronze: finish; silver: one miss at most; gold: no miss and every core 'why' Nailed
act2.length: about 8 to 12 min on the main path (core lessons); the rest are optional at the Academy

blueprint.name: The Blueprint Lab
blueprint.mechanic_rules: Each lesson's in_this_thesis steps, verbatim, shuffled; place them in the thesis's order and a stepping stone lights for each. Then the quiz items.
blueprint.stamp: bronze: finish; silver: one miss at most; gold: no miss and every core 'why' Nailed
blueprint.length: about 8 to 12 min on the main path (core lessons); the rest are optional at the Academy

interviews.name: The Interview Line
interviews.mechanic_rules: Each right answer adds a link to a chain of introductions across a map; a wrong answer loops the chain back on itself and the item returns at the end.
interviews.stamp: bronze: finish; silver: one miss at most; gold: no miss and every core 'why' Nailed
interviews.length: about 8 to 12 min on the main path (core lessons); the rest are optional at the Academy

coding.name: The Coding Floor
coding.mechanic_rules: Two desks, back to back: each item is asked twice in two forms (its quiz item, then a term match). Both right lights the agreement lamp; the lamp count is the stamp.
coding.stamp: bronze: finish; silver: one miss at most; gold: no miss and every core 'why' Nailed
coding.length: about 8 to 12 min on the main path (core lessons); the rest are optional at the Academy

quality.name: Quality Control
quality.mechanic_rules: Say then reveal: each core lesson's 'why' and 'not_this', point-checked; then the quiz items. Nailed opens a gate on the factory line.
quality.stamp: bronze: finish; silver: one miss at most; gold: no miss and every core 'why' Nailed
quality.length: about 8 to 12 min on the main path (core lessons); the rest are optional at the Academy

act4.name: The Switchboard
act4.mechanic_rules: A board of four switches (wall, penalty, thin flows, a holder with no stake) over the motion diagram bound to ch3-10 and ch4-11; toggle rule 1a and the meter shows both results from the cards. Then the quiz items.
act4.stamp: bronze: finish; silver: one miss at most; gold: no miss and every core 'why' Nailed
act4.length: about 8 to 12 min on the main path (core lessons); the rest are optional at the Academy

act5.name: The Shuffle
act5.mechanic_rules: The permutation explainer's shuffle runs on the table (motion diagram bound to ch5-08); then the quiz items, each right answer dropping a marker into the hump.
act5.stamp: bronze: finish; silver: one miss at most; gold: no miss and every core 'why' Nailed
act5.length: about 8 to 12 min on the main path (core lessons); the rest are optional at the Academy

act6.name: The Dials
act6.mechanic_rules: Thirteen dials, eight tinted (assumptions), from the scenario explainer; turn the two that decide the answer, read from ch6-11. Then the quiz items.
act6.stamp: bronze: finish; silver: one miss at most; gold: no miss and every core 'why' Nailed
act6.length: about 8 to 12 min on the main path (core lessons); the rest are optional at the Academy

act7.name: The Falsifier Desk
act7.mechanic_rules: P1 to P5 matched to what would falsify each (propositions[].falsified_by); then the lesson quiz items.
act7.stamp: bronze: finish; silver: one miss at most; gold: no miss and every core 'why' Nailed
act7.length: about 8 to 12 min on the main path (core lessons); the rest are optional at the Academy

CN-CO1.text: Every city has someone who knows where every parcel goes. In Freight City, that's me, Marigold Post.
CN-CO1.speaker: marigold

CN-CO2.text: Freight City runs on parcels and rivalry: carriers chase the same doors, so the shared van so rarely arrives.
CN-CO2.speaker: marigold

CN-CO3.text: You rode in believing the Big Fierce Animal stands alone because it is big.
CN-CO3.speaker: marigold

CN-CO4.text: This is you: a courier with one parcel, your thesis, addressed to the Viva Hall.
CN-CO4.speaker: marigold

CN-CO5.text: Up on the hill, the Hall. Two examiners, five hearts, and questions you won't see coming.
CN-CO5.speaker: marigold

CN-CO6.text: Seven districts are about to correct you, one chapter each. I'll keep the map.
CN-CO6.speaker: marigold

CN-PV-START.text: Last time, you rode into Freight City with one parcel.
CN-PV-START.speaker: marigold

CN-PV1.text: Last time, in the Blank Quarter, you confessed: the data replaced your first idea.
CN-PV1.speaker: marigold

CN-PV2.text: Last time, on Archive Hill: the prize sits exactly where the refusal sits.
CN-PV2.speaker: marigold

CN-PV3.text: Last time, at Method Works: brand and size went off, and the codebook was rewritten.
CN-PV3.speaker: marigold

CN-PV4.text: Last time, in Witness Court: size does not sort willingness, and the chain began to light.
CN-PV4.speaker: marigold

CN-PV5.text: Last time, at Ghent Gate: hours for named operators were not shown to reach the aims. A rule by vehicle and hour survived.
CN-PV5.speaker: marigold

CN-PV6.text: Last time, in Red Cell Square: judge a point by who holds it, and look again whenever it changes hands.
CN-PV6.speaker: marigold

CN-PV7.text: Last time, on the Rooftops: the question answered, both halves. The Hall is waiting.
CN-PV7.speaker: marigold

CN-PV-MISS.text: One that slipped past you last time. Have another look.
CN-PV-MISS.speaker: marigold

CN-A1-1.text: Chapter one. Every field draws a map of where it has been. This one has a blank.
CN-A1-1.speaker: marigold

CN-A1-2.text: Horizontal collaboration: organisations at the same point in the supply chain, working together to gain what none could gain alone.
CN-A1-2.speaker: marigold

CN-A1-3.text: In the blank live the shippers, who own and send the goods: documented, but under-examined as a category.
CN-A1-3.speaker: marigold

CN-A1-4.text: Meanwhile parcels multiplied, the workforce barely grew, and where it has been measured, freight does more than its share of the harm.
CN-A1-4.speaker: marigold

CN-A1-5.text: The old remedy, competitors' parcels on one van, has mostly died. The survivors were driven by a single commercial enterprise.
CN-A1-5.speaker: marigold

CN-A1-6.text: And this is your old idea: the Big Fierce Animal, the large carrier that stands alone because it takes everything within reach.
CN-A1-6.speaker: marigold

CN-A1-7.text: Freight FM is on air, and Vera Static wants one answer before the news: where are the shippers?
CN-A1-7.speaker: marigold

CN-A1-8.text: Across the street, someone is taking notes. You'll meet her properly at the end.
CN-A1-8.speaker: marigold

CN-A1-9.text: Your job in the Blank Quarter: where the shippers are, what the traffic is doing, and the one sentence, said aloud.
CN-A1-9.speaker: marigold

CN-A2-1.text: Chapter two. Archive Hill, where the field keeps its papers, and where a search finds only what it can see.
CN-A2-1.speaker: marigold

CN-A2-2.text: In the first review, one search string was cast across several databases and screened, stage by stage, down to a small set of studies.
CN-A2-2.speaker: marigold

CN-A2-3.text: Run again, it returns none of the papers in the field's own citation trail. A string finds only what it can see.
CN-A2-3.speaker: marigold

CN-A2-4.text: Corrected, it ran again in an open index anyone can use. Most of what it found names no one who begins.
CN-A2-4.speaker: marigold

CN-A2-5.text: Ada Stacks keeps the trail. She knows which shelves are empty, and why.
CN-A2-5.speaker: marigold

CN-A2-6.text: The field's models put the biggest prize where rivals share the most customers. Remember that. The carriers have something to say about it.
CN-A2-6.speaker: marigold

CN-A2-7.text: Between the shelves, someone is reading the same review, pen ready. He hunts overclaims first.
CN-A2-7.speaker: marigold

CN-A2-8.text: Your job on Archive Hill: what the string caught, the shelf it missed, and the condition rivals pool under.
CN-A2-8.speaker: marigold

CN-A3-1.text: Chapter three. Method Works, where the question is built before the answer.
CN-A3-1.speaker: marigold

CN-A3-2.text: First the paradigm, critical realism. Then a retroductive approach: from the regularity to the mechanism that would produce it.
CN-A3-2.speaker: marigold

CN-A3-3.text: A design in four stages, each stage's evidence feeding the next, in the order the method guide recommends.
CN-A3-3.speaker: marigold

CN-A3-4.text: The people were chosen for the question, not the industry: those who convene, fund, regulate, study and broker collaborations.
CN-A3-4.speaker: marigold

CN-A3-5.text: Clement Stamp keeps the consent slips and the ethics approval. He stamps everything twice.
CN-A3-5.speaker: marigold

CN-A3-6.text: Sam and Sal Whistle mark the same match apart, then settle every disputed call.
CN-A3-6.speaker: marigold

CN-A3-7.text: And Polly's survey runs on the side, read for scale and nothing more. It tests no link.
CN-A3-7.speaker: marigold

CN-A3-8.text: Up on the gantry, the note-taker from the Blank Quarter is back. She knows every table by heart.
CN-A3-8.speaker: marigold

CN-A3-9.text: Your job at Method Works: the blueprint, the permits and microphones, the codings, and the Methods Academy across the road.
CN-A3-9.speaker: marigold

CN-A4-1.text: Chapter four. Witness Court. The interviews take the stand, and your old idea stands trial.
CN-A4-1.speaker: marigold

CN-A4-2.text: Every count here is a count of transcripts, and each account of an arrangement is a row: a count of accounts, not of arrangements.
CN-A4-2.speaker: marigold

CN-A4-3.text: In the dock, the Big Fierce Animal revs its engine. The charge: standing alone because it is big.
CN-A4-3.speaker: marigold

CN-A4-4.text: In the mirrors, the same firm says yes in one place and no in the next.
CN-A4-4.speaker: marigold

CN-A4-5.text: And at the back, a telephone. Head Office: never in the room, always on the line.
CN-A4-5.speaker: marigold

CN-A4-6.text: Manny Docks has the ledger: every arrangement described, and what held it together.
CN-A4-6.speaker: marigold

CN-A4-7.text: Everyone talks about trust. Watch what actually holds each arrangement together, and where it comes from.
CN-A4-7.speaker: marigold

CN-A4-8.text: In the gallery, the reader from the library has found a seat. Pen ready.
CN-A4-8.speaker: marigold

CN-A4-9.text: Your job in Witness Court: the mirror pairs, the veto above the room, what binds, and who sets the hours.
CN-A4-9.speaker: marigold

CN-A5-1.text: Chapter five. The second half of the question: what achieves collaboration's aims where collaboration between rivals does not?
CN-A5-1.speaker: marigold

CN-A5-2.text: Over the district looms the Receiver's Clock: the hours when receivers will take goods in. It limits any rule by hour.
CN-A5-2.speaker: marigold

CN-A5-3.text: Tilly Tolerance gives you a window. Not a minute more.
CN-A5-3.speaker: marigold

CN-A5-4.text: Ghent, the one city that writes hours into the permit itself, category by category, in law.
CN-A5-4.speaker: marigold

CN-A5-5.text: A permit at every hour, cameras at the cuts, and a fine for anyone without one.
CN-A5-5.speaker: marigold

CN-A5-6.text: And one delivery class held every hour, through every cut, for years.
CN-A5-6.speaker: marigold

CN-A5-7.text: Lotte Brug sets each Dutch sign beside its English meaning, and corrects your assumptions, gently.
CN-A5-7.speaker: marigold

CN-A5-8.text: Across town, the Locker Market: same lockers, different owners. Watch who delivers.
CN-A5-8.speaker: marigold

CN-A5-9.text: Lockie Keys asks who owns a locker before asking what is in it.
CN-A5-9.speaker: marigold

CN-A5-10.text: On the bridge, your note-taker reads the Dutch beside the English. So should you.
CN-A5-10.speaker: marigold

CN-A5-11.text: Your job here: the clock, the gate, the lockers, and Polly's tally.
CN-A5-11.speaker: marigold

CN-A6-1.text: Chapter six. The answer to the question, and a rule with no nucleus.
CN-A6-1.speaker: marigold

CN-A6-2.text: A locker bank held by a firm that sells no delivery. Rivals deliver side by side.
CN-A6-2.speaker: marigold

CN-A6-3.text: Then it is sold to a carrier.
CN-A6-3.speaker: marigold

CN-A6-4.text: The rules ask who may use it, not who holds it. None looked again.
CN-A6-4.speaker: marigold

CN-A6-5.text: Red Cell Square. The kiosk has no logo, no nucleus, and no stake in anyone's customers.
CN-A6-5.speaker: marigold

CN-A6-6.text: Corra Puscle keeps the keys. She sells no delivery, and is proud of it.
CN-A6-6.speaker: marigold

CN-A6-7.text: On Penny Slate's scale: the saving and the penalty for staying out, against the exposure and the cost of the wall.
CN-A6-7.speaker: marigold

CN-A6-8.text: Penny shows every formula, including the ones that lose money.
CN-A6-8.speaker: marigold

CN-A6-9.text: And the Big Fierce Animal is back: smaller now, still armoured, fierce on its own street.
CN-A6-9.speaker: marigold

CN-A6-10.text: Across the square, your reader underlines one word, twice. You can guess it: proposed.
CN-A6-10.speaker: marigold

CN-A6-11.text: Your job in Red Cell Square: the paradox and its mirror, the rule with no nucleus, and lawful, and fierce.
CN-A6-11.speaker: marigold

CN-A7-1.text: Chapter seven. The Rooftops, where the question is answered in its own words.
CN-A7-1.speaker: marigold

CN-A7-2.text: So far: a map with a blank on it, a review that shared the blind spot, a design in stages, and one question.
CN-A7-2.speaker: marigold

CN-A7-3.text: Seven districts, coloured in. Now both halves of the answer: when collaboration succeeds, and what achieves its aims where it does not.
CN-A7-3.speaker: marigold

CN-A7-4.text: It comes down to two things: who wants the same door, and who can bind the people who do.
CN-A7-4.speaker: marigold

CN-A7-5.text: Digits wants one last run through the numbers. Every number has an address.
CN-A7-5.speaker: marigold

CN-A7-6.text: On the roof, the Grill is warming up. It finds the gap you hoped nobody would mention.
CN-A7-6.speaker: marigold

CN-A7-7.text: And Vera is back on air, as promised. One last interview before the Hall.
CN-A7-7.speaker: marigold

CN-A7-8.text: In the Hall, both note-takers set your thesis on the table. They have read every page.
CN-A7-8.speaker: marigold

CN-A7-9.text: Answer the question in its own words, and the doors open.
CN-A7-9.speaker: marigold

CN-A7-10.text: Your job on the Rooftops: the answer on air, Digits' numbers, the Grill, and a dress rehearsal.
CN-A7-10.speaker: marigold

CN-A1-T1.text: Off air, the red lamp goes dark. Vera asks the question she kept off the radio.
CN-A1-T1.speaker: marigold

CN-A1-T2.text: The thesis was not designed to reach the conclusions it reaches. Expect to be asked about that.
CN-A1-T2.speaker: marigold

CN-A2-T1.text: Ada has read the field's models and the field's carriers side by side. Now she holds a page to the light.
CN-A2-T1.speaker: marigold

CN-A2-T2.text: Hold on to it. In Red Cell Square, this paradox meets its mirror.
CN-A2-T2.speaker: marigold

CN-A3-T1.text: Your working claim walks onto the pitch. The second coding is the referee, and it has red cards ready.
CN-A3-T1.speaker: marigold

CN-A3-T2.text: Brand and size go off. Overlap and the boundary of sharing come on, and the codebook is rewritten from what survived.
CN-A3-T2.speaker: marigold

CN-A4-T1.text: All rise. The court has heard both halves of the interviews.
CN-A4-T1.speaker: marigold

CN-A4-T2.text: Size does not sort willingness. Overlap does, unless a wall, a penalty or an owner with no stake outweighs the exposure.
CN-A4-T2.speaker: marigold

CN-A5-T1.text: Lotte opens the city's own model, in Dutch, with her English beside it.
CN-A5-T1.speaker: marigold

CN-A5-T2.text: Partitioned between operators, time is not shown to achieve the aims. Set by vehicle and hour, naming no operator, it survives.
CN-A5-T2.speaker: marigold

CN-A6-T1.text: Here the overlap paradox meets its mirror. Watch the heaviest pan.
CN-A6-T1.speaker: marigold

CN-A6-T2.text: In the paradox zone, a point held by a party with no stake keeps the exposure at the display alone.
CN-A6-T2.speaker: marigold

CN-A6-T3.text: And so the fifth link lights, hollow. Proposed, not found.
CN-A6-T3.speaker: marigold

CN-A7-T1.text: The studio lamp glows red one last time. Vera has a final question.
CN-A7-T1.speaker: marigold

CN-A7-T2.text: The last reversal is your own.
CN-A7-T2.speaker: marigold

CN-SAYIT.text: Your turn. Say it aloud, word for word.
CN-SAYIT.speaker: marigold

CN-K4-LINKS.text: Overlap. The boundary of sharing. The binder. Power.
CN-K4-LINKS.speaker: marigold

CN-LR1.text: Time to deliver. One parcel, and every district you cleared, on the way down.
CN-LR1.speaker: marigold

CN-LR2.text: At the foot of the steps, the Animal stops. This part, you do on your own.
CN-LR2.speaker: marigold

CN-H1.text: The Viva Hall is open. Go when you're ready.
CN-H1.speaker: marigold

CN-H2.text: These three could use another look first.
CN-H2.speaker: marigold

CN-H3.text: From here on, I'll be quiet. The Hall is yours.
CN-H3.speaker: marigold

CN-EL1.text: The Evidence Locker: the appendices, one room each, a tipster at the door and a grill on the roof.
CN-EL1.speaker: marigold

CN-EL2.text: Ten rooms, ten keepers, and the evidence behind the chapters.
CN-EL2.speaker: marigold

CN-EL3.text: If a part is held by the author, say so: held by the author, available on request.
CN-EL3.speaker: marigold

CN-R-A-G.text: The Interview Café: the questions you took into every interview, and the table of who took part.
CN-R-A-G.speaker: marigold

CN-R-B-C.text: The Ethics Office: the information sheet, the consent form, and the record of approval.
CN-R-B-C.speaker: marigold

CN-R-D-K.text: Survey Square: the questionnaire as respondents saw it, and every table it produced.
CN-R-D-K.speaker: marigold

CN-R-E-F.text: The Archive Library: both searches, as run and as corrected, and the papers the first string could not find.
CN-R-E-F.speaker: marigold

CN-R-H.text: The Depot: the ledger of every arrangement described, one row per account.
CN-R-H.speaker: marigold

CN-R-I-L.text: Coders' Tower: the coding files and their cautions, and the coding of the arrangements for the fifth link.
CN-R-I-L.speaker: marigold

CN-R-J.text: Ghent Gate: the city's Dutch extracts, each beside its English rendering.
CN-R-J.speaker: marigold

CN-R-M.text: The Locker Market: the review of locker networks, and the rules that call a point neutral.
CN-R-M.speaker: marigold

CN-R-N.text: The Council Office: the savings scenario, a worked example and not a forecast.
CN-R-N.speaker: marigold

CN-R-O.text: The Claims Registry: the register of claims behind the fifth link. Parts are held by the author, available on request.
CN-R-O.speaker: marigold

CN-NA1.text: Not today. Every answer is still out there, in your own districts. Ride back, and come again.
CN-NA1.speaker: marigold

CN-W1.text: The chain lights over the city, the last link hollow: proposed, not found. You can say every link of it.
CN-W1.speaker: marigold

CN-W3.text: Down in the street, rivals still want the same doors.
CN-W3.speaker: marigold

CN-W5.text: And that's the story of Freight City. Goodnight, Doctor.
CN-W5.speaker: marigold

CN-MJ1.text: A long list in red ink, a cold cup of tea, and a parcel that will get there.
CN-MJ1.speaker: marigold

CN-MJ2.text: The story isn't finished. One more ride to the Hall, and it could be.
CN-MJ2.speaker: marigold

CN-STOP.text: Shift over, and saved. The city will be here when you are.
CN-STOP.speaker: marigold

CN-RESTART-STEP.text: Back to the start of that step. Everything you've learnt stays with you.
CN-RESTART-STEP.speaker: marigold

CN-RESTART-ACT.text: Back to the start of this district. Everything you've learnt stays with you.
CN-RESTART-ACT.speaker: marigold

CN-RESTART-ROOM.text: Back to the start of this room. Everything you've learnt stays with you.
CN-RESTART-ROOM.speaker: marigold

CN-FRESH.text: A fresh map. Your backup is kept, if you need it.
CN-FRESH.speaker: marigold

CN-SAYOWN.text: Your turn. Say it aloud, in your own words.
CN-SAYOWN.speaker: marigold

CN-GOODNIGHT.text: Goodnight, Freight City. Everything is saved.
CN-GOODNIGHT.speaker: marigold

CN-MORNING.text: Good morning, Freight City. Let's pick up where you left off.
CN-MORNING.speaker: marigold

CN-ACADEMY.text: The Methods Academy: how every part of the thesis was done, and why it was done that way.
CN-ACADEMY.speaker: marigold

CN-BAND.text: A new light on the bike. Your readiness just moved up a band. Nice.
CN-BAND.speaker: marigold

CN-K1.text: The Blank Quarter is coloured in. Here is its line, word for word.
CN-K1.speaker: marigold

CN-K1-NEXT.text: Next time: Archive Hill, where one search string meets the shelf it missed.
CN-K1-NEXT.speaker: marigold

CN-K2.text: Archive Hill is coloured in. Here is its line, word for word.
CN-K2.speaker: marigold

CN-K2-NEXT.text: Next time: Method Works, where the question is built before the answer.
CN-K2-NEXT.speaker: marigold

CN-K3.text: Method Works is coloured in. Here is its line, word for word.
CN-K3.speaker: marigold

CN-K3-NEXT.text: Next time: Witness Court, where your old idea stands trial.
CN-K3-NEXT.speaker: marigold

CN-K4.text: Witness Court is coloured in, and the chain is lighting. Here is the court's line, word for word.
CN-K4.speaker: marigold

CN-K4-NEXT.text: Next time: the Receiver's Clock, Ghent's gate, and a market full of lockers.
CN-K4-NEXT.speaker: marigold

CN-K5.text: Ghent Gate is coloured in. Here is its line, word for word.
CN-K5.speaker: marigold

CN-K5-NEXT.text: Next time: Red Cell Square, and a locker bank that changes hands.
CN-K5-NEXT.speaker: marigold

CN-K6.text: Red Cell Square is coloured in. Here is its rule, word for word.
CN-K6.speaker: marigold

CN-K6-NEXT.text: Next time: the Rooftops, where the question gets its answer.
CN-K6-NEXT.speaker: marigold

CA-K1-VERA.text: Back on air before the Hall. Keep that parcel dry.
CA-K1-VERA.speaker: vera

CA-K1-ANIMAL.text: Seven districts? I'm still bigger than all of them.
CA-K1-ANIMAL.speaker: animal

CA-K2-ADA.text: Every shelf you need is in the Archive Library. Come back any time.
CA-K2-ADA.speaker: ada

CA-K2-ANIMAL.text: Models. I'd still never share my doors.
CA-K2-ANIMAL.speaker: animal

CA-K4-MANNY.text: Court adjourned. The ledger stays open at the Depot.
CA-K4-MANNY.speaker: manny

CA-K4-ANIMAL.text: Ordinary size now. Still don't want rivals on my street.
CA-K4-ANIMAL.speaker: animal

CA-K5-LOTTE.text: Tot ziens. That means see you soon.
CA-K5-LOTTE.speaker: lotte

CA-K5-ANIMAL.text: Same lockers, different owners. So who holds them?
CA-K5-ANIMAL.speaker: animal

CA-K6-CORRA.text: Look again whenever the keys change hands.
CA-K6-CORRA.speaker: corra

CA-K6-ANIMAL.text: So it's my street that makes me fierce. Not my size.
CA-K6-ANIMAL.speaker: animal

CA-LR-VERA.text: Freight FM, signing off. Go and give them the one sentence.
CA-LR-VERA.speaker: vera

CA-LR-ADA.text: A string finds only what it can see.
CA-LR-ADA.speaker: ada

CA-LR-SAM.text: Brand off. Size off. Overlap and the boundary of sharing on.
CA-LR-SAM.speaker: sam

CA-LR-MANNY.text: Size doesn't sort willingness. And most were bound from outside.
CA-LR-MANNY.speaker: manny

CA-LR-TILLY.text: The receiver sets the window. Not a minute more.
CA-LR-TILLY.speaker: tilly

CA-LR-LOTTE.text: Time survives as a rule by vehicle and hour that names no operator.
CA-LR-LOTTE.speaker: lotte

CA-LR-CORRA.text: Judge a point by who holds it. Look again whenever it changes hands.
CA-LR-CORRA.speaker: corra

CA-LR-DIGITS.text: Every number has an address. You know the way now.
CA-LR-DIGITS.speaker: digits

music.brief: The Freight City theme: swaggering, bright, never menacing. 96 bpm, D minor turning to F major; square-wave bass, triangle lead, claps on 2 and 4, a bicycle-bell accent. Loopable 16 bars; 104 bpm for the Long Ride, 120 bpm in D major for wins.
A celesta-like music box plays four notes of the theme with a page-turn swish.
Blank Quarter: foggy detuned pad in A minor, sparse pizzicato, a radio-station feel, 88 bpm; calm and mission stems.
Archive Hill: harpsichord-like arpeggios in D dorian, brushes, page rustles, 96 bpm; two stems.
Method Works: factory percussion at 104 bpm, metallic clanks, a whistle motif, E minor; two stems.
Witness Court: a light courtroom march at 92 bpm, timpani-like sines, walking bass, C minor; two stems.
Ghent Gate: a waltz in 3/4 at 100 bpm, accordion-like saws, carillon bells when the clock appears, G lydian; two stems.
Red Cell Square: a heartbeat bass pulse, bright marimba and brass, F major, 108 bpm; two stems.
The Rooftops: wide pads at 88 bpm, B-flat major, a slow build into the theme; two stems.
Evidence Locker: vault pads in B minor, soft echo, 90 bpm.
Methods Academy and Night Shift: calm, focused lo-fi with brushed drums, warm electric piano and a light bell motif, 80 bpm.
Waiting Room: quiet chamber strings and a ticking pulse, restrained, not scary, 70 bpm.
A tuba-like low saw through a 400 Hz low-pass, an oom-pah stomp; an octave higher and lighter from Act 4.
A two-note woodwind 'hm-hm', B then G, with vibrato.
A reverse swell of 1.5 s into a chord that turns from minor to major.
Bells: link 1 C5, link 2 E5, link 3 G5, link 4 C6 (a major chord); link 5 a hollow open fifth G5 and D6, softer, with a long tail.
v2's low drone on D2 and A2, then a pulse, then tension stems, darker each round; silence on killers.
The theme at 104 bpm with each district's motif layered in for 4 bars as he passes.
A filtered-noise rain bed and a soft piano line in A minor that resolves to C major as the Animal shelters him.
The full theme in D major at 120 bpm with bells.
The theme, relaxed, at 88 bpm.
A warm, short resolving phrase on piano and soft strings.
A gentle music-box lullaby in F major.
A rising, hopeful three-chord phrase with a bird-like whistle.
A playful tag-game cue at 140 bpm with a four-note inspector chime, never a siren.
A bouncy race cue at 140 bpm.

audio.engine: Tone.js 15.5.65, two stems a cue (calm ride, mission) cross-faded over 1.5 s
